name: Onyx Devs Lab enterprise AI case-study evidence register
limitations: Client identities, raw records, and confidential baselines are not published

cases.name: Turning retail transaction data into operating decisions
cases.operatingChallenge: Transaction data existed, but inventory, workforce, and loss signals were fragmented. The business needed better decisions without replacing the operational ERP.
deliveredIntervention: Connected existing transaction data through a separate analytics layer.
Designed missing workforce and inventory-loss data modules.
Applied inventory forecasting and market-basket analysis to operational decisions.
Kept recommendations reviewable by operators rather than automating high-impact decisions invisibly.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The published metrics come from project records and describe the delivered scope and pilot validation. They should not be extrapolated as expected results for another organisation.

cases.name: An AI-native production line for accounting operations
cases.operatingChallenge: Accounting work was split across client files, collection, bookkeeping, review, tax preparation, and exception handling. AI needed to assist the full workflow without obscuring evidence or professional accountability.
deliveredIntervention: Mapped 12 business domains, 52 screens, and 9 production workspaces.
Separated deterministic accounting rules from AI judgement.
Designed queues, retries, status tracking, evidence chains, and explicit human takeover.
Kept final official submissions in a controlled path where direct APIs were unavailable.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The published figures separate mapped product scope from pilot workflow validation. They do not claim financial outcomes, and regulated decisions and official submissions remain subject to qualified human review.

cases.name: Legal AI that returns every conclusion to its evidence
cases.operatingChallenge: Law-firm operations and large case files created two different information problems: fragmented business status and high-risk evidence retrieval across very large dossiers. A fluent answer was not enough; lawyers needed coverage, provenance, and explicit review.
deliveredIntervention: Connected leads, clients, matters, milestones, tasks, contracts, and receivables in one operating model.
Tracked ingestion by file, page, and text chunk so missing or failed material remained visible.
Combined keyword and vector retrieval with file, page, source text, and confidence coordinates.
Applied matter-level access, audit trails, exception queues, and lawyer approval before formal output.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The validation figures come from a controlled project sample and lawyer-labelled reference set. They demonstrate the tested workflow, not legal accuracy for every jurisdiction or matter.

cases.name: Recruiting automation with context, evidence, and send control
cases.operatingChallenge: Fast reply generation did not solve incomplete conversation context, stale candidate profiles, duplicate sends, or uncertain delivery. Automation needed to coexist with recruiters rather than take over their working interface.
deliveredIntervention: Used a local connector to reuse the authorised recruiter session and synchronise visible candidate history.
Refreshed structured profiles when context changed, separating facts, inferences, confidence, and missing information.
Supported manual, copilot, and controlled-autopilot modes per candidate.
Serialised sends, enforced idempotency, and reread the sent message to verify completion.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The published validation covers synchronisation, send verification, and workflow time in a controlled pilot. It does not claim improved hiring outcomes without a longer recruiting cohort.

cases.name: A trusted data path from industrial operations to management decisions
cases.operatingChallenge: Production information was fragmented across equipment, paper records, and isolated systems. Management received delayed summaries, but connecting the data could not compromise safety-related industrial control.
deliveredIntervention: Mapped material movement, weighing, quality testing, vehicle energy, and production records to accountable business objects.
Established a controlled data interface between PLC information and management systems.
Unified operational dashboards, mobile access, permissions, validation, and audit records.
Added business questions and exception explanation above the trusted data layer, not direct AI control of production.
cases.evidenceBoundary: Validation covers data-record completeness, collection timeliness, and operator acknowledgement in the delivered project scope. Safety-related actions remain under authorised site personnel.

cases.name: Credit research automation without hiding the source
cases.operatingChallenge: Analysts repeatedly collected, reconciled, and reformatted information across internal files and public sources. Faster drafting was useful only if material facts, conflicts, freshness, and provenance remained visible.
deliveredIntervention: Modelled the research task, evidence levels, report structure, and analyst approval boundary.
Connected internal materials with current public financial information through a deduplicated retrieval pipeline.
Separated facts, inference, and risk judgement while attaching sources to material conclusions.
Recorded analyst edits and missing evidence as evaluation data for future releases.
cases.evidenceBoundary: The validation sample measures fact recall, citation coverage, and first-draft time. The system does not replace credit, investment, or trading decisions.
